newsitem.title: GERMANY: German regional banks say Telekom issue a success.
newsitem.headline: German regional banks say Telekom issue a success.

text.p: DUESSELDORF, Germany, Nov 19 (reuter) - Germany's regional banks and their associated savings banks said on Tuesday that they placed shares worth more than 2.3 billion marks with private investors in the Deutsche Telekom flotation on Monday.

Those regional banks who formed part of the consortium said that this amounted to a 28 percent share of the total issue of eight billion marks worth of shares issued to domestic private investors, which they said was a great success.
The Savings Bank Institute said it had received a total of 580,000 orders from private investors.
